def build_request(system, turns):
    messages = []
    for i, content in enumerate(turns):
        role = "user" if i % 2 == 0 else "assistant"
        messages.append({"role": role, "content": content})
    return {
        "model": "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        "max_tokens": 1024,
        "system": system,
        "messages": messages,
    }

req = build_request("You are terse.", ["Ping?", "Pong."])

print("model=" + req["model"])
print("system_len=" + str(len(req["system"])))
print("messages=" + str(len(req["messages"])))
print("roles=" + ",".join(m["role"] for m in req["messages"]))
